exclusion_reason: Exact-duplicate-text-with-conflicting-label AND near-duplicate-template-with-conflicting-label rows: the same normalize_code() template maps to more than one distinct label elsewhere in the raw dataset. This is label noise, not benign duplication - kept out of train/val/test entirely (saved separately in excluded_conflicting_labels.csv, not silently dropped).
split_group_definition: ml.feature_pipeline.normalize_code(vulnerable_line) - identical function used for TF-IDF/count text normalization
known_limitation: The dataset has no application/project identifier, so this is a near-duplicate-grouped split (via normalize_code() template matching), not a true application-level split - identical to the limitation already documented in ml/data/dataset_report.json.
